name: MYRC
oneLiner: MYRC is Blox's ringgit stablecoin backed 1:1 by MYR-denominated reserves at Malaysian financial institutions and gated to verified Malaysian residents.
collateral: Malaysian ringgit-denominated reserve assets held at Malaysian financial institutions; current asset classes, institutions, and weights are not publicly disclosed
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption against Malaysian Ringgit via Malaysian banking rails (FPX). Eligibility requires Malaysian eKYC (MyKad) and a linked Malaysian bank account; mint authority on each chain is restricted to a Blox-controlled key.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: BLOX describes MYRC as a 1:1 Malaysian Ringgit stablecoin minted and redeemed through domestic banking rails and backed by ringgit-denominated reserve assets held at Malaysian financial institutions. The reviewed product, transparency, and whitepaper materials do not identify the current asset classes or institutions and do not support the prior Maybank and UTMB attribution.

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-31: the live BLOX MYRC page still states 1:1 MYR backing in trustee accounts and independent Malaysian-accountant audits. The 2025-08-29 Tommy Ung & Partners PLT reasonable-assurance examination reports 1,211,350.50 MYRC in circulation against 1,211,350.50 MYR held, with a reserve breakdown of 100% cash and bank deposits readily withdrawable for redemption. Current institutions, account segregation, balances, and later-period attestation are not disclosed; the structured envelope is nevertheless now precisely 100% cash/MYR with immediate stated liquidity.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The latest independent report identifies 100% cash/MYR bank deposits, but current financial institutions, provider shares, balances, and legal segregation terms are not disclosed.

notices.title: Issuer not licensed
notices.message: Blox Blockchain Sdn Bhd does not hold a Bank Negara Malaysia or Securities Commission Malaysia license. SC Malaysia disclaimed jurisdiction in 2022; BNM has not yet established a payment-stablecoin framework as of 2026.

notices.title: Small float, single-jurisdiction
notices.message: MYRC has a small circulating float and its reserve disclosures identify only Malaysian financial institutions, without naming providers or publishing provider concentration.

mintAuthority.summary: MYRC uses OZ AccessControl on EVM chains. On Ethereum, MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe 0xcca0793222422e8ac1dd48db1aa691f9d360a1c2 (Safe v1.3.0 L2, no modules/guard). All role grants confirmed via RoleGranted event scan. The Ethereum MYRC token is a non-proxy immutable ERC-20 (EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots are zero; verified source has no upgrade surface).

controls.label: Blox MYRC minter/admin Safe (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xcca0793...) = true. RoleGranted event scan (Blockscout getLogs, topic0=0x2f8788...) confirms MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE granted to 0xcca0793... at block 17970681; a second DEFAULT_ADMIN grant to 0xe16f1d... was later revoked (RoleRevoked confirmed). getOwners() on 0xcca0793... = [0x76b7d8..., 0xb4bc50..., 0xa35acdb...]; getThreshold() = 2. modules() returned sentinel only (no modules). masterCopy slot = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Safe v1.3.0).

controls.label: MYRC Solana mint and freeze authority (issuer keypair)
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 425797741, getAccountInfo on mint myrcAs6b... returned mintAuthority and freezeAuthority Df8T8pvE..., a System-Program-owned non-executable account (issuer keypair, EOA-equivalent).

review.evidence: MYRC Ethereum uses OZ AccessControl (non-enumerable). MINTER_ROLE confirmed held by 2-of-3 Safe 0xcca0793... via hasRole at block 25295023 and corroborated by RoleGranted event log. Safe has 3 signers, threshold 2, no modules, no guard. Arbitrum/Base deploy same implementation (same bytecode); ARB deployer 0xdae4932... does NOT hold MINTER_ROLE — consistent with safe-based role management applied post-deploy on all chains. Solana mint not checked (non-EVM, low supply on Solana vs EVM). Solana mint authority resolved at slot 425797741: issuer keypair (EOA-equivalent). Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): Tommy Ung & Partners PLT issued monthly reserve attestations through 2025-11-30, but the expected subsequent monthly reports are absent as of 2026-07-15; current recurring reconciliation is therefore not established. Securities Commission Malaysia's public register does not establish Blox as a prudential stablecoin issuer. Reconciliation review (2026-08-08): the monthly reports the 2026-07-15 pass recorded as absent after 2025-11-30 do exist, published under cdn.blox.my/attestations. Tommy Ung & Partners PLT (AF 002378), Chartered Accountants Malaysia, issue ISAE 3000 (Revised) reasonable-assurance opinions that MYR-denominated assets held equal or exceed MYRC in circulation - verified for 2025-11-30 (831,090.83 MYRC) and 2026-06-30 (2,217,790.25 MYRC, signed 2026-07-21), with reports present for every month probed in between. Recurring third-party reconciliation is therefore established. Supervision stays non-prudential: Blox's own product term sheet states MYRC does not constitute electronic money or a payment instrument unless and until Blox obtains Bank Negara Malaysia approval.

sources.label: Tommy Ung & Partners PLT: MYRC reserve report, ISAE 3000 reasonable-assurance opinion, 30 June 2026
